thread_text:
kevin: Heads up — bringing up halo-q4 (PTQ int8) in onboard canary. Seeing intermittent toolcall JSON parse failures when KV prefix includes control chars. Small sample attached.

maria: saw this too. Failing ~0.8% on int8 canary vs ~0.02% on fp16. dump: `{"tool":"upsert","args": ["key","val\u0000"]}` — parser bails with 'Unexpected control char'

jon: sounds like the postprocess strip/escape logic in the int8 runtime path is dropping the escaping step. Maybe quantized tokenizer outputs raw \u0000 sometimes.

taylor: quick repro — ran 1000 requests with randomized kvprefix bytes, int8 canary had 7 fails, fp16 0. reproducible locally. Steps I used: 1) run replay 2) enable json-warn logging 3) compare tokenization outputs.

ops-bot: deploy: halo-q4-int8-canary rolled to 2 nodes at 17:15; GPU/host metrics OK; alert muted for noise.

kevin: I'm capturing a minimal failing transcript, putting it in /tmp/halo-fail.log (snip):
```
Request: {"prompt":"...","kv_prefix":"user:\u0000binary"}
Emitted JSON: {"tool":"upsert","args":["user:binary"]}
Runtime error: JsonParseError: unexpected control char at pos 24
```

maria: suggestion: add a postprocess guard that enforces JSON escaping on toolcall args before emitting. Also try bumping retry_budget to 2 for this canary to reduce visible flakes.

jon: can we avoid string-level fixes? adding sanitizer in the runtime token-emission path (escape non-printables) would be minimal and reversible. Better than editing tokenizer itself.

taylor: concern: sanitizer may change behavior for customers that intentionally pass binary args. Need to run acceptance tests against integrations that expect binary payloads.

kevin: plan: 1) add sanitizer behind a feature flag 2) run 10k replay compare in dedicated env (mirror traffic) 3) if diffs are isolated to parse-fail reduction, roll forward on canary.

maria: I'll open a quick PR with sanitizer + flag. tagging `eng-ml` and `eng-runtime`. PR will include unit tests and a small perf microbenchmark.

jon: also add a smoke harness that runs tokenization -> emission -> parse for the common toolcall shapes so we catch regressions early.

kevin: assigned: maria PR, taylor replay job, jon acceptance checklist. Reconvene in ~3h in this thread.

taylor: started replay job: https://replay.internal/runs/9001 — queued on dedicated cluster, running against the int8 canary :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ops-bot: replay job 9001 queued on dedicated cluster.

maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/halo/pull/321 — sanitizer behind flag `sanitize_kv_prefix`. Added config docs and unit tests.

kevin: nice. If replays look good, keep flag default-off for hosted for 48h then flip-on for canary-only. Postmortem if any user-facing diffs. :thumbsup:

jon: I'll prepare an acceptance checklist (binary-arg integration tests + funcall conformance) and run it on the mirror.

kevin: thanks — will update infra ticket with results and next steps.

maria: quick note for follow-up: add telemetry counter for 'sanitizer-applied' and 'sanitizer-induced-diff' so we can quantify impact.

kevin: agreed, add counters and a dashboard tile in the canary view.

(taylor will paste replay summary when job completes)
